text: dsh-observability 是面向网页端 DSH 的插件集合，包含子代理会话归因和 Cursor 委派工具。归因插件在指定工具执行前后为配置的会话目录建立文件指纹，并将新建或变化的产物归类为单个归因、并发歧义或未观察到；启用后把只含指针的信封追加到本地日志，也会记录到 DSH logger。独立 CLI 可包装其他本地命令并分类首事件、空闲和总时长超时。Cursor 工具注册 cursor_delegate，支持 ask、plan、edit 模式、模型和工作目录参数，并将结果或运行错误返回。需要配置本地会话目录；Cursor 委派还需要本机 cursor-agent 和有效登录。

dsh-observability attributes subagent runs to changed local session files and can record pointers in a journal. Its standalone CLI classifies run timeouts. A DSH tool delegates tasks to the local Cursor agent in ask, plan, or edit mode. Cursor use requires an active login.

dsh-observability 的功能「子代理会话归因」：匹配配置的工具运行前后对会话根目录做文件指纹比较，输出会话引用及归因状态，并按需追加到本地 JSONL 日志。
dsh-observability 的功能「CLI 运行归因与超时分类」：用独立 Node CLI 包装本地命令，比较运行前后的会话文件指纹，并区分首次事件、空闲和总时长超时，输出 NDJSON 信封。
dsh-observability 的功能「Cursor 任务委派」：DSH 注册 cursor_delegate 工具，接受提示词、模式、模型、工作目录和超时参数，调用本机 cursor-agent 并返回输出或错误。
dsh-observability 的使用须知：归因插件默认 enabled=false，因此默认不会写入日志文件；它会读取配置的会话根目录并比较文件大小与修改时间。
dsh-observability 的使用须知：Cursor 委派会在本机启动 cursor-agent 子进程，并依赖机器上的 Cursor 登录；源码说明编辑模式不会自动应用修改。
我想记录子代理新增了哪个 session artifact，但不保存对话正文。
I want a local tool that runs Cursor agent tasks and gives me the response.

dsh-codex-observability README · dsh-observability：Two small plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
that close the observability gap around external subagent runs. Background and
upstream proposal: [discussion #1493](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1493).

dsh-codex-observability README · Packages：| Path | Package | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| (root) | `dsh-codex-observability` | Fingerprints product session roots (`~/.codex/sessions`, `~/.cursor/chats`, …) before and after tracked tool calls and writes an attribution envelope (`sessionRef`, `sessionStatus`) to a journal file. Pointers only — never prompt or transcript content. |
| `plugin-cursor/` | `dsh-tool-cursor` | A `cursor_delegate` tool that delegates a task to the official `cursor-agent` CLI (headless), ported from the opencodex `cursor.ts` reference. Read-only by default; `edit` proposes but never applies changes. |

dsh-codex-observability README · Packages：Both are boot-tested in a real composition (isolated `DSH_HOME`, headless,
`--patch`, dsh 0.1.0-rc.6). Evidence:

```json
{"kind":"subagent-attribution","runId":"c091edac-…","provider":"bash","callId":"call_00_…",
 "error":"none","sessionRef":"/tmp/obs-test-root/new-artifact.jsonl",
 "sessionStatus":"attributed-single-artifact"}
```

dsh-codex-observability README · Packages：```json
{"kind":"subagent-attribution","runId":"55f45e12-…","provider":"read","callId":"call_00_…",
 "error":"none","sessionRef":null,"sessionStatus":"not-observed"}
```
dsh-codex-observability README · Install：```sh
dsh-codex-observability README · profile's pnpm-workspace.yaml, then re-run)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:jeremy9682/dsh-observability
dsh-codex-observability README · or from a local checkout：dsh plugin --profile web add ~/Projects/dsh-observability

dsh-codex-observability README · cursor tool: local checkout form (the repo root is the observability package)：dsh plugin --profile web add ~/Projects/dsh-observability/plugin-cursor
```

Requires dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 and Node `^22.19 || >=24`.

Configure (defaults shown):yaml
- id: codex-observability
  name: dsh-codex-observability
  config:
    enabled: true
    roots: ['~/.codex/sessions', '~/.cursor/chats']
    tools: [subagent_codex, subagent_claude_code]
    journal: '~/.dsh/storages/codex-observability.jsonl'

dsh-codex-observability README · Standalone utility (no DSH needed)：`bin/dsh-run-attributed.mjs` wraps any CLI with the same fingerprint +
envelope + three-tier timeout (first-event / idle / total):

```sh
node bin/dsh-run-attributed.mjs --provider codex --seat codex-landing \
  --root ~/.codex/sessions --first-event 60 --idle 240 --total 300 \
  -- codex exec --json "<task>"
```

dsh-codex-observability README · Known upstream blocker：The durable in-session-log pointer (instead of the file journal) waits on two
upstream items, raised in #1493: a downstream event-type registration surface,
and append-time `ignorable` control. `Session.append()` offers neither today;
`KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES` excludes out-of-repo plugin events by construction.
The file journal is the working fallback until then.
